settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Standard shipping takes 3-7 business days depending on your location. You will receive tracking updates via email/SMS once your order is dispatched.

settings.question: Is this suitable for all skin types?
settings.answer:
Yes! The formulation is designed to be gentle yet effective for:

  • Dry & dehydrated skin — boosts hydration and strengthens the barrier.
  • Aging & mature skin — restores elasticity and reduces wrinkles.
  • Oily & combination skin — lightweight, non-greasy texture.
  • Sensitive skin — free from irritants, making it safe for reactive skin.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer:
Returns are eligible within 48 hours of delivery for all orders placed on beyondbeyond.co.in. To ensure a smooth return process, please follow these steps:

  1. All items must be unused and returned with the original invoice.
  2. Items should be in their original packaging, including price tags, labels, boxes, and any accompanying accessories.

Note: All returned products will undergo a quality assessment before approval.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Currently, we ship within India. We are working on expanding our availability to international markets soon!
